$comment: Style pack: Marketing Pro. Learned from the user's reference ad Video-2306 (a real-estate agent promo; measured, nothing copied) and the user's brief. Colours sampled from its frames (purple, neon ends, strike red); teal is a close default. Camera rules and planner: tools/recipes/marketing-pro.mjs. Workflow: .agents/skills/style-marketing-pro/SKILL.md.
label: Marketing Pro
use: Promo talking-head edits from ordinary footage: a camera that always moves (1.3x base, eased zoom-outs to 1.0x, 1.6x punches on sentence starts), two-tier body captions and one hero keyword per sentence behind the head, styled by meaning.

serif.$note: bundled; serif caps and the upright parts of italic heroes

captions.$note: two-tier body caption at chest height (about 0.47 H); one clause per group

sfx.$note: Sparse: a soft whoosh on a hero, a pop on tags and logos, a shine on stats.
